history.text: Great! Now that we've completed the greeting, let's move on to the next stage. Can you please introduce yourself and share a bit about your background and experience?
I’m Ken. I have five years of experience in backend development, mainly with Java and Spring at an insurance company.
What specific projects have you worked on in your previous role?
[stage_change -> behavioral_q1]
I built a claims batch pipeline. It handled processing claims.
Can you describe the challenges you faced while working on the claims batch pipeline?
There were performance issues. Had to optimize it.
How did you go about resolving those performance issues?
I analyzed the queries and improved indexing. Then, I made some refactoring.

Thank you for your detailed responses, Ken! Now, let's move on to the next behavioral question. 

Can you describe a time when you had to work collaboratively with a team to achieve a common goal? What was your role in the team, and how did you contribute to the project's success?
[stage_change -> behavioral_q2]
I worked with the team on a project integration. I handled backend services. We coordinated to meet deadlines.
What specific contributions did you make to ensure the project's success?
I wrote the APIs and fixed bugs as they came up.

Thank you for your insights, Ken! Let's move on to the final behavioral question.

Can you share an experience where you had to dive deep into a technical problem to find a solution? What steps did you take, and what was the result?
[stage_change -> behavioral_q3]
I had a bug in the data processing. Debugged the logs and traced the source. I found a logic error and fixed it. It worked after that.
What tools or methods did you use to debug the issue?
I used logging, and also a debugger in my IDE.

Thank you so much for your thoughtful responses, Ken Okafor. Let me wrap up. 

It was great to hear about your experiences and insights, especially regarding your work on the claims batch pipeline and how you handled challenges in your projects. We appreciate your time today and will be in touch regarding the next steps. Have a great day!
[stage_change -> closing]
Yeah, thanks. You too.
You're welcome, Ken! Take care, and best of luck with your future endeavors!
